_preregistration.rung: the AR window is strictly left, so damage can only spread RIGHTWARD: asymmetry must be 1.000 up to the injected block's width. A failure stops the script -- it would mean the causal window is not being applied, which is a harness bug not a finding
_preregistration.primary: do area, fill and front_width vary across checkpoints where lambda does not?
_preregistration.deflation: if every shape scalar is a monotone function of lambda, the cone carries nothing beyond it and this closes; rho against lambda is reported for each
_preregistration.stores: the cones themselves, so the next shape question needs no re-run
_preregistration.boundary: one family, one radius, one temperature; a geometry measurement, not a model-facing claim

verdict: RUNG (the causal window, checked rather than assumed): damage asymmetry about the injection is 1.0000-1.0000 across 24 runs. Exactly one-sided, as a strictly-left window requires -- the cone spreads rightward and carries no leftward mass at all. PRIMARY: across checkpoints, 2 of 3 shape scalars have any span to correlate with. area +1.000, fill +1.000. Every READABLE shape scalar tracks lambda, so the cone carries nothing beyond its growth rate and this closes -- the registered deflation. NOT READ: ['front_width'] -- span 0 across all runs. The causal window derived from the front's own support is only 2-6 sweeps at N = 48, which cannot resolve a front width, so this scalar is unmeasurable at this geometry rather than uninformative. An earlier version reported rho = +0.829 for it, from a ranking bug that ordered a constant vector by input position. BOUNDARY: one family, one radius, one temperature. A geometry measurement of the construction, not a model-facing claim. The cones are stored, so the next shape question needs no re-run.

_analysis_provenance.note: sha256 of the analysis source at write time, plus the repo-local import closure. If any of these does not match the file on disk, the analysis was produced by a different version of the code -- re-run it before reading the numbers (issue #38; the imports half closes the same hole one level down the import graph). Third-party package versions are NOT covered.

asymmetry_by_sweep.note: Damage is one-sided only until the rightward front meets itself around the ring. Async random-order updating means within-sweep reach is bounded by the visit order, NOT by r, so the synchronous bound N/(2r)=12 sweeps is wrong by ~6x. Any SPATIAL readout (area, fill, front width, asymmetry) is valid only over one_sided_sweeps. lambda_ca is unaffected: lyap_from_cone fits cone.sum(axis=1), a COUNT, and wraparound relocates damage rather than creating it.

_note: First measurement of the damage cone as a FIELD rather than as four scalars. No results file in this repo had ever stored one. Includes the causal-window rung: a strictly-left update must give exactly one-sided spread.
